title: EduNUWA style_tags_live
description: Crowd style tags distilled from student feedback. Produced by M2 refresh_crowd_tags, consumed by M3. Lives at data/teachers/{tid}/style_tags_live.json, accumulates across skill versions (NOT inside skill_profile snapshot). Phase 2 feature.

style_embeddings_model.description: Must match M3 query embedding model and skill_profile.style_embeddings_model (M2 H6 / M3 H6). Same field name as skill_profile for unified loading.

support.description: Number of distinct students (deduped by student_hash) who expressed this tag.

cluster_id.description: Owned by M3 global clustering; M2 writes null, M3 backfills in its own index.

embedding_ref.description: Optional Phase-2 vector-store handle; MVP computes at load time.
